3.3 Agent Design Space

The AgentSSL formulation exposes several design choices that can affect how agents explore the space of SSL programs. We focus on three components that are especially relevant to our study: the fitness function, the search strategy, and the language model.

We compile and releaseProgramSelectBench, a precomputed benchmark for unsupervised and active program selection consisting of 16,977 evaluated program instances across six classification datasets. ProgramSelectBench is constructed from the programs evaluated in AgentSSL, including both agent-generated programs and human-designed baselines.

C.3 Selection Results

Forunsupervised selection, we evaluate all the unsupervised metrics discussed in Section A.2 on ProgramSelectBench. Foractive selection, we evaluate several active selection methods including ActiveTesting [28], VMA [34], CODA [27], ModelSelector [38], and an IID baseline.
